decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 27th October 2006, Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front of house, as shown on drawings numbered 4494/100/1 and 494/100/2B, received 27th October 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a single storey side extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informative: The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front of house
